answer: At the nadir of a sybil surge, each agent must post a verifiable bond that is escrowed in a smart‑contract ledger. Peers audit behavior by exchanging signed pearls; when a node proves a duplicate identity, an automated slash burns the bonded stake and rewards honest validators, pushing the attack cost to the horizon of ruin. The resulting fee—typically dozens of tokens per forged identity—makes large‑scale impersonation financially impractical.
